Definition: from G575 and a derivative of G473; to meet away, i.e. encounter:--meet.
BiblicalUsage: The word means to meet someone coming the other way — the ten lepers meeting Jesus as he entered the village, and the man carrying water meeting the two disciples in the city. It is an encounter, not an accident.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe these meetings remind me that Jesus is found on the road, in the middle of ordinary errands and desperate cries alike.
